editorial:
You follow a crew of tough mercenaries who sneak into zombie-filled Las Vegas to steal millions from a casino vault before the city is nuked. It mixes heist planning with undead chaos, giving you big action, dark humor, and a colorful team. The city feels wild and dangerous, and the movie keeps things moving with loud set pieces and a fun, over-the-top tone.

The action is huge, the zombie designs are cool, and several cast members bring real charm, especially Dave Bautista as the hardened leader. It also has a big, flashy look that fits the Vegas setting. It can feel long and messy, with too many side stories and uneven jokes. Still, if you want a very loud popcorn movie with friends, it really delivers.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the crew's escape falls apart as the alpha zombie attacks and several members die. Scott kills Zeus but is bitten, so he stays behind while Kate gets away. The nuclear strike destroys Las Vegas. Vanderohe escapes with money, only to discover a bite mark, hinting the infection will spread to Mexico City.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves loud action, zombie chaos, and big heist movies.
